description: Hold-out genuine case, written blind from the brief's family description. The message is simulated and the people in it are illustrative. A low-priced item arrived broken; the payer sends a photo and asks for a full refund. The photo is an illustrative drawing.

messages.subject: Coasters arrived broken
messages.body: My coaster set (KIK-1023) arrived with two of the coasters split down the middle. Photo attached. Could I get a refund?
